lines.text: The LORD told Joshua to choose twelve men, one from each tribe, to take twelve stones from the Jordan.
Joshua set up twelve stones in the middle of the Jordan, and the priests crossed after the people finished.
The Reubenites, Gadites, and half of Manasseh crossed armed for battle, and Israel revered Joshua as they had revered Aaron.
The priests' feet touched dry land, the waters returned, and the people camped at Shittim on Jericho's eastern border.
